observations: DSH composition remains typed native state; ordered bundles and official dump-config can round-trip without a universal plugin graph.
vHarness Host Truth and authority cannot be restored by copying journals; a fresh Host domain plus live Guest validation preserves the intended authority boundary.
A vHarness P1 claim must be scoped to the Guest runtime actually tested. The current proof covers a non-mock persistent process-Guest, not a model-backed or strongly sandboxed Guest.
A fifth adapter can register through agent_image.adapters and build a valid image using only the installed public SDK; Core schema changes are unnecessary.
Capability evidence and adapter declarations remain separate: adapters list reports installed contracts with runtime_verified false.
release_implications: Epoch 3 satisfies four built-in C0 contracts, four Windows P1 paths, and the clean-room extension test.
Schema freeze may proceed only after the evidence/docs/test audit.
The negative trained-agent Gate E remains independent and still blocks final v0.1.0.
